chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever washes a dead person and shrouds him should perform ghusl (ritual bath) of janabah.

key_terms.غَسَّلَ: washed the body of the deceased
key_terms.غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ritual bath done in the manner of ghusl for janabah
key_terms.كَفَّنَهُ: shrouded him in the funeral cloth

ai.seo_question: What ghusl should be performed by the person who washes and shrouds a deceased body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who undertakes the washing and shrouding of a deceased person. It indicates that such a person performs ghusl in the manner of ghusl al-janabah, showing the importance of taharah in funerary rites.
